# Consolidated agent reference

This file is an index, not a copied documentation bundle. Read the linked canonical pages in full; do not assume that this file alone contains every design requirement.

## Required reading

- `AGENTS.md` — repository-wide agent routing and constraints
- `docs/overview.md` — scope and terminology
- `docs/agent-guide.md` — workflow and code-quality rules
- `ai-rules-project-structure.md` — adaptable Flutter project structure

## Task references

- `docs/foundations.md` — color, typography, shape, elevation, spacing, motion, icons, accessibility, responsive design
- `docs/components.md` — component selection and mappings
- `docs/flutter.md` — SDK/dependency verification, theming, architecture, errors, tests
- `docs/platforms.md` — Android, iOS, tablets, foldables, and device validation
- `docs/evidence.md` — primary sources, limits, and historical research data

## Non-negotiable distinctions

- Material design intent, Flutter API behavior, platform behavior, and application choices are different kinds of evidence.
- `ThemeData.useMaterial3: true` does not establish full M3 Expressive behavior.
- Flutter's baseline widgets may be suitable when verified against the requirement; neither blanket bans nor assumed parity are justified.
- Do not invent dependencies or APIs such as `m3d.design` and `context.m3e`. The optional token snippet must be copied into an app before use.
- Historical inventory, API, and test records do not validate the current target application.
